name: Witch's Grasp
description:
Concentration, up to 1 minute.

Roll Spirit vs Strength against a creature within medium range. On a win, the creature's Speed is reduced to 0 and your roll result becomes the Difficulty. Each round, the creature may spend an action to roll Strength against the Difficulty to end the spell.

If the creature has attacked you or forced you to make an opposed skill check within the last minute and has never been damaged by you, each of its Strength checks are ill-favored.

Describe your Witch's grasp.
successes:
✨: Win or lose, the creature takes HEART damage.

🌞: On a win, the Difficulty increases by 2, and each time the creature rolls a pass against the Difficulty, the spell does not end. Instead, it restores half of its original Speed. On a loss, the spell still takes effect, but only halves the creature's Speed.
